QuestInfo.name: Welcome Home Utah
QuestInfo.1: Camila is trying to prepare a special meal for Utah's return. Defeat #rMutant Ribbon Pigs#k and bring back #b50 cuts of Mutant Pork#k.
QuestInfo.2: You provided a feast of mutant pork to Camila. Hopefully it helped Utah recover his strength.

0.0: I hear you helped Utah. Ugh, that useless crystal marble... Utah is much more important to me than any little trinket! But you helped bring him back here. So thank you!

yes.0: Thank you very much. Utah's exhausted from his journey. Please gather some ingredients so I can make him something delicious.
yes.1: #b50 cuts of Mutant Pork#k should be enough. What? He's probably REALLY hungry.

no.0: I guess I can't MAKE you say yes...

0.1: Uh... I'm sorry, would you do me a favor? It's something I probably couldn't do myself.

1.0: Do you have the Mutant Pork?

yes.0: Wow, that's a lot! I can make huge servings with this. Thank you again. Ah, I'd better start cooking. I hope Utah recovers soon.

item.0: You can get #bMutant Pork#k from #rMutant Ribbon Pigs#k. Of course, they're so big nowadays, but that just means we get more pork from them.
